name: Tree-Support-Extremal Classes Are Projection-Closed
statement: Every coordinate projection of a tree-support-extremal class is tree-support-extremal.
proof: Projection to $Y$ intersects both the shattered-tree support family and the ordinary shattering complex with $2^Y$. Tree-support extremality is equivalent to ampleness together with equality of these two families, and ampleness is projection-closed.
